advisories.message: The documented client invocation uses frpc -c with a configuration path. Preserve supplied arguments and their working-directory context.
Root and capabilities depend on the actual configuration and remain explicit choices. The descriptor pair is tired capacity policy, not an upstream FRP requirement.
An executable-name match is not verification of the binary or its application version.
Use the 1048576 soft/hard pair only when the observed usable ceiling permits it. Unknown or lower ceilings suppress it; explicit limits and saved service snapshots remain unchanged.
